standalone.observation: Works as a self-contained monologue, but the closing "Stay Fluffy, Folks!" is a catchphrase whose full weight depends on knowing the character or show beyond this text.

performer.observation: The gardener is dry-witted and self-aware, addresses the lettuce and an absent visitor directly, and keeps a consistent voice from the opening wheelbarrow line to the close.

storyBetweenCards.observation: The cards move from starting small to organizing to persisting without applause, a real argument accumulates, but the transitions between creatures feel listed rather than built as connected scenes.

individuality.observation: Concrete details (wheelbarrow, compost, lettuce, hinge, fence) ground the satire in a specific world rather than a generic motivational list.

outro.observation: "the lettuce and I start without you" calls back the opening gate image well, but "Stay Fluffy, Folks!" lands right after it as a tonal jolt.

transferable.observation: Each beat repeats one shape, a named animal followed by a single aphorism; that container could hold many different one-line morals on an unrelated topic with little alteration.

resident.observation: She addresses the gate, the lettuce, her own shed and calendar, speaking from inside her routine whether or not anyone is actually there.

fractalCards.observation: Most animals voice general process advice unconnected to their own nature as creatures; few lines make the animal's identity itself the subject of its claim.

flags.observation: "the future is a process of slow, incremental improvement you participate in" reads as a definition statement, flatter than the surrounding garden voice.
"A pigeon, an emu, a duck and a crow" names four creatures in one line but gives none individual distinguishing behavior beyond species name.
"Your nervous system thinks that is death. It is not." introduces therapy-register language that breaks from the gardener's plain diction elsewhere.
The capitalized tag "The Comfort of Maybe" functions like an inserted chapter title rather than spoken dialogue, standing apart from the rest.
"Nobody will clap. Start anyway. The clapping was never the point." repeats the payoff already given in "Nobody clapped, and the place is different.", diluting the motif across two beats.
"Stay Fluffy, Folks!" arrives as a bright catchphrase immediately after the drier closing image, a notable tonal shift.
